text: Entry Requirements Year one entry We welcome applications from high-quality candidates in all subjects with appropriate high school or equivalent qualifications. Students will normally be expected to have a high standing in their high school performance with a minimum B average in all subjects as well as relevant subjects. Year two entry Students who have completed A-levels or International Baccalaureate (or equivalent) will be considered for entry into Year Two, different programmes have different subject-relevant requirements. A-level: BBB IB Diploma: 30 points AP Exams or ACT Tests – High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 Notes: 1. BEng Architecture, BA Filmmaking, BA TV Production & BA Digital Media Arts: admissions for Year Two direct entry and Year Three transfer require a digital copy portfolio review and interview with members of Design School or the Academy of Film and Creative Technology, which can be conducted in person or via internet. 2. BA International Business with a Language: normally international students study Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students study Spanish or Japanese as the language option. For year 2 entry international students, students who are Chinese zero beginners will take an extra 5 credits Chinese language course. For year 2 entry Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students, students should be able to demonstrate an equivalent level of Spanish (DELE/SIELE A1) or Japanese (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test N5). 3. BA Translation and Interpreting: for international and HK/Macao/Taiwan students whose native language is not Chinese, an HSK level 6 or the pass of the aptitude test arranged by the Department of Translation and Interpreting is required. 4. Programmes in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Design, Mechatronics and Technology Science and so on require both Mathematics and Physics. 5. Programmes in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and so on require Mathematics. 6. Programme in Architecture: for Year One entry, Math is required. However, for Year Two direct entry, having a background in Math is desirable but not essential. You can also find more information on entry requirements on our Country/Region list. English language requirements For international applicants, if you are a non-native English speaker, or if you have not previously studied in English, you must have satisfactory English language skills to study at XJTLU. Various English qualifications are accepted: Year one entry IELTS: 5.0 (min 4.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 62 (iBT) Year two entry IELTS 6.5 (min 5.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 90 (iBT) (min 21 in any skill) National/Region Qualifications Africa Ethiopia Ethiopian Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination (ESSLCE) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Australasia Australia Successful completion of year 12 with High School qualification and a satisfactory admission index/entrance rank ATAR (Australian Tertiary Admission Rank) with 86% is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Australian High School qualification examples: Australian Capital Territory Senior Secondary Certificate, New South Wales Higher School Certificate New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) Level 3 is accepted for Year Two entry. Applicants should achieve: – 46 or more credits ranging from Merit to Excellent (excluding Learning Recognition credits), and – including three subjects at Level 3 or above, made up of 12 credits each at Excellent, and – Literacy – 10 credits at Level 2 or above, made up of 5 credits in reading and 5 credits in writing. Numeracy – 10 credits at Level 1 or above. Applicants should provide detailed description of their academic qualification. Europe France French Baccalaureat with 12 overall out of 20 with 12 in specified subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: French Baccalaureat English 13 Germany Zeugnis der Allgemeine Hochschulreife / Abitur with a minimum of 2.5 overall with a minimum of 10 in two Leistungskurse (advanced) subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Abitur English 12 Italy Diploma di Esame di Stato with a minimum of 80% overall is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Netherlands Voorbereidend Wetenschappelijk Onderwijs (VWO) with a minimum of 7 overall out of 10 is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Russia Attestat o Srednem Obshchem Obrazovanii (Certificate of Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Certificate of Unified State Examination may be requested in non-standard applications. United Kingdom (UK) AS-Levels will be considered for Year 1 entry. GCE A-Levels with BBB or IB with 30 points is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. North America Canada High School Diploma will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. Such as: British Columbia: British Columbia Senior Secondary School Diploma with grades BBBBB in grade 12 subjects; Ontario: Secondary School Diploma OSSD with an average of 70%, including six Grade 12 U, U/C, M courses (study in-person on campus for 2-3 years). OSSD awarded outside of Canada must be from an Awarding school listed on the Canadian Government website as a school authorised to award Ontario Secondary School Diploma credits. Other provinces: Secondary/High/Senior School Diploma with 70% average and 70%, 70%, 70%, 70%, 70% in grade 12 subjects. United States of America (USA) High School Graduation Diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above will be considered for Year 1 entry. Students who take AP Exams or ACT Tests will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 South America Brazil Certificado de Ensino Medio with grades of six, and six in relevant subjects. The Caribbean CAPE Diploma including three two-Unit level subjects (excluding core subjects) at grade II with specific requirement in relevant subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry.
